title: Teachers' Day on Oct. 5: No nationwide class suspension, says Palace

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The public has been warned by Malacañang on Sunday against a fabricated graphic circulating online claiming that classes have been suspended on Oct. 5, Monday, for the celebration of National Teachers’ Day. The Presidential Communications Office (PCO), in an advisory posted on its official Facebook page, said it did not issue such an announcement. “The public is advised to refrain from sharing unverified information and to rely only on announcements from official government sources,” the PCO added.
